title: Airflow Dag Freshness SLA
app: Airflow logs via UF; Airflow REST API and StatsD metrics via HEC; metadata DB via DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=airflow:task state="success"
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by dag_id
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>12
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each Airflow DAG and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A DAG can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for Airflow.
implementation: Ingest Airflow success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical DAG exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of DAG by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of Airflow has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
